curation.notes: High-resolution timeshared dual-trap optical tweezers transcription-elongation assay of Mycobacterium tuberculosis RNA polymerase (compared with E. coli RNAP) under assisting/opposing constant force and opposing passive mode, with the inhibitors D-IX216, streptolydigin and pseudouridimycin, plus transcription factors CarD and GreA. Biotinylated RNAP (β' C-terminus) on one bead, transcribed DNA template on the other.

hardware.model_number: timeshared dual-trap optical tweezers (Comstock et al., 2011)

attachment_chemistry: AviTag/BirA or sortase-mediated biotinylation of RNAP β'

handle_sequences.annotations: single-end digoxygenin-labeled DNA template amplified as approximately 4.2 kb (opposing force) or 2.8 kb (assisting force) from pUC19-del-Lac-AC50-MtbrpoBC
molecular-ruler template from pSGUML1T1 with an 8 x repeat of a 63 bp pause c sequence
biotin/neutravidin DNA handle made by PCR with a biotinylated primer

entities.name: M. tuberculosis RNA polymerase holoenzyme (σA), biotinylated on β' (rpoC)

evidence.snippet: We produced the holoenzyme of MtbRNAP with sigma factor A by co-expressing its subunits in E. coli (Gradia et al., 2017).
For both EcoRNAP and MtbRNAP, the attachment to biotin is done via its β' subunit.

entities.name: DNA transcription template (Mtb rpoB/rpoC region, AC50 promoter)

evidence.snippet: We made a single-end digoxygenin-labeled DNA template (without a ruler) using PCR by amplifying approximately 4.2 kb or 2.8 kb from plasmid pUC19-del-Lac-AC50-MtbrpoBC
DNA handles were created using PCR with a biotinylated primer along with another primer, either double-dig labeled or encoding a restriction enzyme site for generating sticky ends for later ligation.
we pre-incubated approximately 1 µM of biotinylated-MtbRNAP with around 10 µM of MtbCarD at 37 °C for 5 min
To obtain MtbGreA, we expressed it as a his-tagged protein in E. coli BL21(DE).
